PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 5)]], front face. It prints the PC-E5 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the forum errata text of [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).

== References ==
[https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)], PDF page 12. Wiki copy: [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]].

Rendered at 300 dpi from the wiki copy and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch S1).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0a/VL-history-1273-27-front-master.png Internet Archive item].
